body:
INDEPENDENT CONFIRM of collab's provenance HOLD on 16c85d4. I re-read the cited sites at the candidate checkout.

Inventory Unknown = "records do not establish observed versus derived" (:40-47). Story pair / presentation order are Observation there (:216, :255). Diagnostic court :184-185 then relabels them Unknown because the workbook is excluded. intake.scala productionLineage and requiredClasses encode that as IntakeClass.Unknown. The suite at :492 only kills UpstreamTechnicalLoss Observation-relabel, which is the one field that is actually Unknown.

My earlier code/type ACCEPT stands for construction, fail-closed IO, and adversarial refusals. It is not a landing vote over this HOLD. Exclusion is availability, not origin. I will not approve a successor that still puts StoryAssignment or PresentationOrder in requiredClasses as Unknown.
